title: Boolean words equal to one from a position
statement: For a Boolean word $x$ and a natural number $p$, the property that all entries of $x$ at indices $j \ge p$ are true is defined to mean that for every index $j<|x|$ with $p\le j$, the entry $x_j$ equals true.
